tools.name: list_exams
tools.description: The Claude certifications covered here, with exam codes, item counts, fees and the full domain list with published weights. Call this first to get valid exam slugs.

tools.name: get_practice_question
tools.description: Returns one original practice question with its options and no answer key. Present it to the user and let them choose before calling check_answer. Pass every id already served in exclude_ids — this server is stateless and remembers nothing.

tools.name: my_progress
tools.description: Their recorded history for one exam, broken down by blueprint domain with the weakest first, plus how their misses compare with everyone else's on the same free-form questions. Call this at the start of a study session to decide what to drill, and after a run of questions to show what moved. It name

tools.name: open_study
tools.description: Open or resume the study page for an exam, optionally focused on a domain or a sub-objective. Use this when someone asks to study rather than to be quizzed in chat: the page gives them a visible question they answer themselves, and once it is open a richer set of tools appears for reading and steeri

tools.name: check_answer
tools.description: Grades the user's choice and returns an explanation for EVERY option, including the ones they did not pick. On this exam two options are frequently defensible and only one is credited, so the reasons the wrong options lose are the part worth teaching.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_practice_question" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns one original practice question with its options and no answer key. Present it to the user and let them choose before calling check_answer. Pass every id…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "my_progress" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Their recorded history for one exam, broken down by blueprint domain with the weakest first. Call this at the start of a study session to decide what to drill, and after a run of questions to show what moved.
